records.title: ILILT: Implicit Learning of Inverse Lithography Technologies
records.accepted_version_observation: Title/authors/venue notice and all acquired PDF pages, including embedded appendices/checklist/datasheet, inspected by same AI. Independent identity/version decision remains pending.

cvm.physics_assessment: A lithography estimator is called within the iterative mask optimization and provides simulated wafer-image feedback (provisional C1 for simulator-coupled mask design). Appendix describes optical/resist approximations and says optical parameters are foundry-calibrated in principle; this review found no foundry calibration file, calibrated process profile or independent physical validation.
cvm.physical_evidence_assessment: Author-reported simulated wafer print, EPE and process-variation-band analysis under nominal/non-nominal simulator conditions. No physical wafer/metrology validation or independent solver audit identified; authors state production-level QoR remains future work.
cvm.manufacturing_assessment: Pre-fabrication semiconductor mask optimization with industry-relevant simulated EPE/PVB measures (M1). No production line, fabricated wafer, yield/defect KPI, external tool/site/lot holdout, integration or operational qualification established.

claims.paraphrase: Forward lithography supplies inference feedback; finite unrolled BPTT with weighted mask supervision is implemented in the described method, while end-to-end DEQ training is future work.
EPE is averaged violation count at contour probes; PVB measures area across process corners. Neither is a measured wafer metric.
GPUILT: EPE0.21/PVB4656/runtime4; CFNO8:0.25/4674/0.4; P2PHD8:0.08/4695/0.8. The10x runtime ratio belongs to CFNO8 and the best EPE belongs to P2PHD8; combine only same-setting quantities.
Production-level designs/manufacturing QoR remain future. Foundry calibration is discussed without an acquired calibration file. A pix2pixHD backbone link is not a full ILILT recipe/checkpoint.

claims.paraphrase: Solver-generated training and conditional diffusion compose fields/components; learned energy is probabilistic and the noise objective is not a physical residual. Neighbor/BC coverage and local Markov assumptions limit scope.
FNO-v0.0102 versus M2PDE0.0080 gives1.275x, not fourfold; coupled FNO0.0264 is smaller than decoupled0.0320. Retain table/prose conflict as unresolved.
Relative-L2 table unit1e-2 must be explicit. Multi-component training derives rows from16-element assemblies, so component rows share source simulations and are not independent assembly samples.

Table3 epsilon2.07 versus3.31 yields37.46% reduction, while Table18 original-DDPM1.94 yields41.39% for a different setting. Table20 timing uses DDIM50 and normalized forward cost assumptions. RD speedup0.064 indicates slower inference.
Simplified reactor/plane-strain models, excluded physics, coupled-training comparators, input-information differences and initialization exceptions prevent blanket superiority or process acceptance.

Record Eq8/9/Algorithm2 mapping questions separately; numerical-reference relative errors are author claims. An independent PDE residual/BC/interface validator and frozen unseen conditions are still needed.

records.title: DrivAerNet++: A Large-Scale Multimodal Car Dataset with Computational Fluid Dynamics Simulations and Deep Learning Benchmarks
records.accepted_version_observation: Title/authors/venue notice and all acquired PDF pages, including embedded appendices/checklist/datasheet, inspected by same AI. Independent identity/version decision remains pending.

cvm.physics_assessment: Parametric geometry plus CFD with OpenFOAM v11, steady incompressible RANS using k-omega SST, quality/convergence checks and mesh sensitivity. This is a governing-equation simulation pathway (C1); it is not a learned model constrained by equations at inference, and design-point fidelity is bounded by the reported solver, mesh, boundary conditions and Reynolds-number scope.
cvm.physical_evidence_assessment: Author v2 reports baseline drag comparisons with TUM wind-tunnel values across four vehicle configurations, with reported differences about 2.18-4.88%, and mesh sensitivity for one fastback case (relative error 8.21% at 6M cells vs 2.17% at 24M against reference CFD). This is stronger than a simulation-only score but remains author-reported; the present audit did not reproduce the runs or verify uncertainty/independent external lots.
cvm.manufacturing_assessment: Designed to avoid geometries that are difficult to manufacture and supports conceptual automotive design/aerodynamics, but evidence is simulation and initial-design support. It does not generate factory process histories, defects, material states or production-lot variation; no vehicle production or field-operational KPI is established. Keep H2 boundary pending human scope adjudication.

records.title: TokMan:Tokenize Manhattan Mask Optimization for Inverse Lithography
records.accepted_version_observation: Title/authors/venue notice and all acquired PDF pages, including embedded appendices/checklist/datasheet, inspected by same AI. Independent identity/version decision remains pending.

cvm.physics_assessment: Differentiable forward lithography simulation feeds the mask optimization objective (provisional C1 for simulator-coupled process design). Manhattan/binary geometric constraints are not themselves evidence of calibrated resist/optics physics or physical wafer fidelity.
cvm.physical_evidence_assessment: Author-reported simulated print fidelity/runtime and geometry compliance (V2); publisher-indexed excerpts available, full experiment tables/supplement not retrieved, and no independent simulator, wafer measurement, uncertainty or holdout audit performed.
cvm.manufacturing_assessment: Semiconductor mask optimization and design-rule/manufacturability-oriented geometry (M1). No observed production line, metrology-linked lot, yield/defect KPI, external tool/site transfer, or operational qualification identified in this bounded audit.

claims.paraphrase: Manhattan axis/offset parameterization, differentiable lithography training loss and optional ILT post-correction occupy C2/C3/C5. They do not by themselves establish calibrated wafer physics.

Point topology is structured, but offsets are real scalars. Quantization, polygon validity, exact DFM thresholds, clean-delta construction and denoising/MSE objective combination require release-level mapping. Gaussian diffusion is not automatically optical corruption.

Mean contour-distance EPE differs from violation count. Shot count is a mask-writing proxy; TAT includes inference/refinement but excludes I/O, and training cost is outside this TAT. Training uses a32H20 platform, about80GB at batch40, testing oneA100.

Table1 EPE2.70 to2.16 is20% using rounded values; Table2 exact displayed averages differ slightly. TokMan L TAT1.57 exceeds Multi-ILT1.33, contradicting a universal all-metrics superiority reading of AppendixA. Baseline-specific shot ratios must be named.

Full-chip, SRAF flexibility and real industrial production data remain untested. Checklist open-code Yes defers release and new-assets says none released. This dated PDF statement does not prove current global absence; DiT terminology is not evidence of an LLM.

89,697 rearranged upstream layouts require grouping by original cell/design. All20 test cases in AppendixA are benchmark simulations, and selected mask/resist images do not demonstrate fabricated wafer or writing-tool acceptance.
